digest.component_or_area: LLM provider substrate - Bedrock cutover gate
propositions: Bedrock inference-profile ids (us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 and us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8) are invokable in AWS account 896586841071 / us-east-1 with both bare and temperature=0 payloads
Payload parity holds: system prompt, messages, tools, max_tokens, and temperature fields are byte-identical across Anthropic and Bedrock providers; only model_id differs

Tool parity holds: identical set of 6 tools (comment_ticket, list_directory, read_file, resolve_symbol, search_files, show_ticket) with matching names, descriptions, and input schemas across both providers
Provider routing is clean: 0 non-Bedrock calls across 84 case-runs on each measured class slot (standard and frontier)
Capability difference is symmetric and explicit: temperature=0.0 is withdrawn from opus on both providers via supports_temperature: False override; sent to sonnet on both
Bedrock runs 9.9% faster on standard slot and within 0.1% on frontier slot vs direct Anthropic (latency-only, informational)
